data.review_body:
I am very unhappy with my recent experience. I applied for a price adjustment because the price of my item dropped within the 30-day window. I provided clear proof, but the system refused it anyway( PO-141-09566580859513363-D01)

Instead of a proper refund, I was given a standard coupon that expires in just a few days. I do not want to be forced to make another purchase under a strict time limit just to receive credit that I am rightfully owed under your price adjustment policy.

Do not rely on Temu’s "30-day price adjustment policy." Even if you have clear screenshot proof that the price dropped, their automated system will likely refuse it—even if you have clear proof. If you go to the chat box to complain, they will not give you your money back. Instead, they close your support ticket and give you a standard coupon onto your account.
Here is the catch: The coupon expires in just a few days.

EDIT: To Temu BOT, please do not ask for order number with a mail, read it in this post. Your automated, canned responses do not address my issue and offer no real assistance.
